title: Echo
desc: Desperation sets in when Prakash's failing marriage is threatened by something otherworldly, prompting him to resort to black magic. He soon uncovers shocking family revelations.

title: Rangabali
desc: Shaurya, a young, easygoing man, moves to a city and falls in love with a girl. During this journey he comes face-to-face with local disputes and secrets about his hometown.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

title: Rowdy Rakshak
desc: A special agent is assigned to protect the prime minister, who later gets assassinated. He is tasked with finding the group responsible for the assassination.
